$description: Which text goes on which background. The token build checks every pair in Light and Dark and fails below the minimum (WCAG 2.2 AA: 4.5 : 1 for text). The result is dist/docs/contrast.json, which the Colors page shows. Not from Figma – edit here.

groups.name: Content surfaces
groups.use: Pages, cards, panels, inputs, selected rows.

groups.name: Brand surface
groups.use: Bold brand areas: hero, banner, highlighted plan.

groups.name: Inverse surface
groups.use: Tooltips, snackbars, dark areas in the light theme and vice versa.

groups.name: Filled actions
groups.use: Primary and danger buttons in every state.

groups.name: Solid feedback
groups.use: Strong badges and status dots with text.

groups.name: Media
groups.use: Text on images and video – always on the overlay/media scrim. Checked on a white image, the worst case.

groups.name: Code
groups.use: Syntax colors in Code block – on its surface, on the page and on a highlighted line.
